stagingImplementation: lib/hiking/snow-screening.ts; historical importer names intentionally unchanged pending versioned pipeline migration
thresholdAttribution: Retained local conservative screening threshold pending unambiguous ECMWF parameter-specific clarification; not proof that a cell is a glacier
onThresholdReached: Block new recommendation publication pending source and spatial review; retain provenance. Do not infer glacier coverage or trail snow depth from the threshold alone.
persistentSnowCondition: All 12 valid monthly snow-day probabilities equal 1; missing months never establish absence of persistent snow and instead trigger an insufficient-data hold.
existingHolds: Preserve all existing holds. Reclassification of this threshold alone cannot release a destination.
releaseEvidence: Document exact source parameter and units, independently supported hiking corridor and elevation range, spatial relation to selected cell, and independent seasonal snow evidence. Resolve contradictory evidence before release; no requirement to invent a replacement cell.
conversion: Do not convert SWE to physical snow depth without compatible density and spatial/temporal semantics.
migration: Replace misleading official-glacier-indicator names and messages consistently in importer, metadata, validators, tests and documentation. Preserve interpretation/version of historical metadata; do not relabel old artifacts as newly processed. Keep the numeric blocking boundary unchanged.
